_about: CSEPrompts 2.0 (Raihan et al., JIIS 2025) numbers to compare against. Only GPT-4o's coding scores are stated as numbers in the text (Sec. 5.1.3); the others are read off Fig. 3 (+-2 points; their means agree with Table 4) and Fig. 4. Fig. 3's 'CSEPrompts - MOOCs' bar is taken to be the repo's CodingSites split (it is the easier one, as the text says CodingSites is) and 'CSEPrompts - Academic' the Academic split; to be confirmed with the author. The paper's pass@1 is 'passes all test cases on its first attempt', graded from manually cleaned code.
